blocks.content: Explore three panels with different fill opacity to see how the shading under a line changes.
Open **Time series graphs** and scroll to the **Styles** row.
**Lines** has fill opacity 0. There is no shading under its line.
Scroll to the **Fill opacity** row. Its panels use fill opacity 10, a faint shade under each line.
Scroll back to the top. **Simple graph** uses fill opacity 40. The shading is stronger, and where series overlap, one can hide another.
The shading changes. The line positions don't. Darker fill doesn't mean a larger value.
You've compared three fill strengths. Fill opacity changes shading, not the values or the scale.
